description: Optional SQLite address/road artifact, built manually from a local OSM extract by ztm-planner geocoding. No automatic refresh or downloads.

metadata.bbox: JSON [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees; default [20.3, 51.8, 21.8, 52.7]. No antimeridian wrap.
metadata.source: Absolute path of the local OSM PBF or XML source, not a download URL.
metadata.timestamp: UTC ISO 8601 build timestamp, not the OSM snapshot timestamp.
metadata.counts: JSON object of address, street, address_nodes, address_ways, street_ways, invalid_address_nodes, invalid_relevant_ways and invalid_address_rings counts.

semantics.nullability: Describes values emitted by the builder, not SQL NOT NULL constraints; the prototype core DDL is preserved.
semantics.display_tags: Address street/house/city are original addr:street/addr:housenumber/addr:city values. Street rows use name and addr:city, with empty house. Missing tags stay empty; city is never inferred.
semantics.osm_id: node/<OSM id> or way/<OSM id>. Not a unique key: a building/highway way can emit both address and street rows.
semantics.coordinates: WGS84 lon/lat. Addresses are nodes or planar building-ring centroids inside bbox; concave centroids may lie outside the building. Streets use an equirectangular length-weighted midpoint of the full road, which may lie outside bbox.
semantics.geometry: NULL for addresses; street TEXT is a JSON list of [lon, lat] pairs in source order, with at least two distinct points. Complete, unclipped named highway ways whose polylines intersect bbox are retained.
semantics.places_fts: FTS5(text, tokenize='unicode61', prefix='2 3 4'); rowid equals places.id. Text is street + space + house + space + city, normalized by casefold, ł->l, NFKD and removal of combining characters. Whitespace is preserved.
semantics.places_rtree: One row per place id. Point bounds for addresses, full geometry bounds for streets. SQLite RTree rounds float32 bounds outward; readers must allow rounding.
semantics.limitations: No relations, town inference, address interpolation or full polygon topology validation. Missing referenced nodes invalidate the whole way. Open/degenerate building rings are skipped. An artifact with no usable places is rejected.
semantics.publication: A unique temporary database in the output directory is integrity/completeness checked, closed, chmod 0644 and fsynced before atomic replacement. Failed builds preserve the previous output and remove only their own temporary file.
semantics.legacy: The unversioned scratch prototype has the same core tables, normalization and road JSON format. Readers may accept missing schema_version as legacy; maintained builds always emit schema_version=1 and status=complete. Legacy building representative points can differ from maintained centroids.
